card.name: Words before taking a bus or ride
card.fires_on: Small words (can, to, I, a) and word starts (b of bicycle, h of hitchhikers) right where a verb like catch, take or hitch a ride or transport could come next. Mostly in travel and transit text.

modes.label: Travel linking words
modes.description: A small word after a place or transport mention where a verb like catch or take a bus could follow.
modes.example: The bus stops in the center of town, from which you<< can>> climb the hillside to the Convent

modes.label: Inside transport words
modes.description: Partway through words about rides and vehicles, such as bicycle, hitchhikers or Metrorail.
modes.example: genetic hitch<<h>>ikers coming soon to a genome near you
